Guides / Friends & trading / Trading

Trading

Trade levels, rarity ranks, fees, the island rule, offers and Lucky trades.

Trade one-on-one with friends live, or send an offer they can accept later (offers last 3 days; 5 waiting at most). Each of you can make 5 trades a day.

Rarity ranks and trade levels

RankPokémonFee
Trade Lv1Common and Uncommon$1,000
Trade Lv2Rare$10,000
Trade Lv3Shiny, Alpha and Perfect$50,000
Trade Lv4Legendary, Mythical, Ultra Beast, Void, Prismatic, Spectral, Mirage and Gilded$250,000

Your trade level with a friend starts at 1 and rises with days as friends and friendship points: Lv2 after 3 days and 3 points, Lv3 after 7 days and 10 points, Lv4 after 14 days and 20 points. You can trade Pokémon up to your level's rank.

Friendship points come from what you do together: a gift opened between you +1, a trade +3 (1 a day), a raid boss beaten in the same raid party +2 (3 a day), a cheer on the other's rare find +1 (3 a day) and a friend battle +1 (2 a day). Point at the hearts next to a friend's name (tap on a phone) to see your level and today's points.

Rules

  • Island rule: you can receive a Pokémon once you've reached its home island.
  • Legendary, Mythical, Void and Prismatic Pokémon need 5 badges to receive.
  • A Pokémon you got in a trade can be traded again 30 days after it arrived.
  • The fee is paid for the Pokémon you receive (it never takes you below $0).
  • Pokémon above your level cap arrive "shadow dropped" to the cap and grow back with your badges.
  • Lucky trades: about 1 in 10 trades are Lucky for both sides: the Pokémon's IVs reroll to 28–31.
  • Trades also evolve trade-evolution Pokémon (every trade branch, e.g. Clamperl).
